covers: US October CPI, the first hours of the US session, the JSE close and SA manufacturing data, Tuesday 10 November 2026
headline: Wall Street extends losses after the hot US inflation print; the US 10-year yield reaches 4.99% and the Nasdaq slips below 25,000
summary: The JSE All Share closed at 114,693.44 and the Top 40 at 106,738.05, while the rand weakened to R16.54/$ (Yahoo Finance, 10 Nov 17:51 SAST); Stats SA data showed September manufacturing output down 3.5% year on year (EWN, 10 Nov). In New York the S&P 500 fell to 7,483.24 and the Nasdaq to 24,996.37 by 17:51 SAST, down from 7,523.54 and 25,188.22 an hour earlier, as the US 10-year Treasury yield rose to 4.99% after October consumer prices rose 0.4%, more than expected (CNBC headline, 10 Nov). Gold was at $4,057.40 and Brent at $90.53 (Yahoo Finance, 10 Nov 17:51 SAST); US rates near 5% remain the main pressure on the rand, emerging-market assets and gold.

items.title: US October CPI rises 0.4%, more than expected; markets weigh a bigger Fed hike in December
items.summary: CNBC reports US consumer prices rose 0.4% in October, more than expected, complicating the Fed's inflation fight (headline, 10 Nov). A CNBC piece the same day says markets are now weighing whether the Fed needs a larger-than-usual hike in December.

items.title: US 10-year Treasury yield rises to 4.99% from 4.86% on Monday
items.summary: The benchmark yield moved further up during the US session and is now just under 5%. Higher US yields tend to pull money out of emerging markets like South Africa and weigh on non-yielding gold.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 17:51 SAST

items.title: S&P 500 7,483.24, Nasdaq 24,996.37: losses deepen through the first hours of trade
items.summary: By 17:51 SAST the S&P 500 had fallen to 7,483.24 from 7,523.54 at 16:58 SAST, and the Nasdaq Composite to 24,996.37 from 25,188.22. The Nasdaq has fallen slightly more than the S&P 500 as bond yields rise.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 17:51 SAST

items.title: Chip stocks rally despite the Nvidia scandal
items.summary: CNBC reports chip stocks rallying on Tuesday even as questions about Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang continue (headline, 10 Nov 2026).

items.title: JSE All Share closes at 114,693.44, Top 40 at 106,738.05
items.summary: Final closing levels for 10 November (an earlier print showed 114,551.87). Both indices remain above last week's levels: the All Share closed at 112,739.40 on 6 November.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 close

items.title: Manufacturing output falls 3.5% year on year in September
items.summary: Stats SA's September manufacturing production was down 3.5% from a year earlier, a smaller fall than the 4.3% decline in August. Factory output has now contracted for a second month, alongside weak mining data.

items.title: Unemployment rises to 33.7% in Q3 2026, from 33.6% in Q2
items.summary: Stats SA's Quarterly Labour Force Survey released this morning.

items.title: Rand R16.54/$, R18.46/€, R22.07/£
items.summary: The rand is weaker against the dollar after the US inflation surprise (R16.37/$ at 11:41 SAST), but steady against the euro and pound.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 17:51 SAST

items.title: Gold $4,057.40, platinum $1,544.80, Brent $90.53, copper about $13,852/t
items.summary: Gold is little changed from an hour ago after its earlier drop on the CPI data; Brent is hovering around $90 a barrel.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 17:51 SAST

items.title: Nvidia: US House China committee chair demands answers over CEO's alleged affair with a Chinese spy
items.summary: Adds political pressure a week before Nvidia's 17 November results (CNBC headline, 10 Nov 2026). No change to our rating.

items.title: AngloGold Ashanti: gold at $4,057.40 as US yields near 5%
items.summary: Gold is holding just above $4,000 an ounce. A sustained move higher in US real yields is the main near-term risk to gold-miner earnings; this does not change our rating.
items.source: Yahoo Finance via LRC Market Dashboard, 10 Nov 2026 17:51 SAST
